Rodrigo Muniz was finally all smiles again as he ended a year-long goal drought to help earn Alvaro Arbeloa his first win and see Fulham breeze past AFC Wimbledon 3-0 in the Carabao Cup. The Brazilian netted his first goal since August 16, 2025 with a fine header back across goal from Kenny Tete's cross after Emile Smith Rowe had nodded the Cottagers in front to all-but secure a third-round trip to West Ham even before half-time.

messages.text: Woad makes promising start at FM Championship

metadata.summary: Lottie Woad made a strong start to the final week of play before next month's Solheim Cup by shooting a four-under opening round at the LPGA Tour's FM Championship.
metadata.content: FM Championship: Lottie Woad makes strong start in Boston on LPGA Tour amid final tournaments before Solheim Cup | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to content FM Championship: Lottie Woad makes strong start in Boston on LPGA Tour amid final tournaments before Solheim Cup England's Lottie Woad four off the early pace at the LPGA's FM Championship, while South Africa's Casandra Alexander shoots course record on day one at KPMG Women's Irish Open; final events on women's tours live on Sky Sports this week before Solheim Cup from September 11 Friday 28 August 2026 00:06, UK Image: Lottie Woad during the first round of the LPGA's FM Championship Lottie Woad made a strong start to the final week of play before next month's Solheim Cup by shooting a four-under opening round at the LPGA Tour's FM Championship. England's Woad is one of 12 members of Anna Nordqvist's European team heading to the Netherlands for the September 11-13 showpiece, live on Sky Sports , and she shot a 68 at TPC Boston on Thursday to sit four shots off the pace set by Korea's Sei Young Kim. Woad, a two-time winner on the LPGA Tour since turning professional last year, picked up all four of her birdies on the front nine to go out in 32 before parring all the remaining holes. messages.text: Fery handed nightmare opener at US Open as top stars learn opponents

metadata.summary: Carlos Alcaraz and Novak Djokovic are on for a US Open collision course following Thursday's draw in New York, while Britain's Arthur Fery has been handed a nightmare opening-round clash against Italian 13th seed Lorenzo Musetti.
metadata.content: US Open draw: Carlos Alcaraz, Novak Djokovic, Arthur Fery, Aryna Sabalenka and Coco Gauff find out first-round opponents in New York | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content US Open draw: Carlos Alcaraz, Novak Djokovic, Arthur Fery, Aryna Sabalenka and Coco Gauff find out first-round opponents in New York Carlos Alcaraz and Novak Djokovic in the same half of the US Open draw as Britain's Arthur Fery is handed a nightmare opening clash; watch the US Open from August 30 live on Sky Sports Tennis and Sky Sports+, streaming service NOW and the Sky Sports app By Raz Mirza at Flushing Meadows, New York Thursday 27 August 2026 19:26, UK Image: Carlos Alcaraz, British hope Arthur Fery and Aryna Sabalenka were all in the draw for the US Open Carlos Alcaraz and Novak Djokovic are on for a US Open collision course following Thursday's draw in New York, while Britain's Arthur Fery has been handed a nightmare opening-round clash against Italian 13th seed Lorenzo Musetti. Defending champion Alcaraz will open his campaign against Roman Safiullin with a potential semi-final meeting with history-chasing Djokovic. It will be the Spaniard's first appearance since recovering from a right wrist injury sustained in April. Djokovic, chasing an elusive 25th Grand Slam title, will face against Argentina's world No 48 Mariano Navone in the first round with the winner to face Matteo Berrettini or Stan Wawrinka, who is playing in his final Grand Slam before retiring.
